integrity: A self-contained mathematical derivation and a reproducible standalone exact-checking program are included. Finite computation is not used as proof of an infinite asymptotic. The general small-urn Gaussian limit is acknowledged as existing mathematical machinery.
scientific_limitations: Fixed retention parameter in (0,1); uniform recursive attachment; annealed full tree-and-site law; eventually signed covariance, not every finite-size sign; no exact finite independence at the critical parameter; full historical priority and independent validation unresolved.
title: An exact closed–singleton covariance and its critical sign transition in site-percolated recursive trees
